description: This file defines a route for creating a new note in a Remix application. It includes a loader function that creates a new note and redirects to its page, and a component that renders nothing.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Creates a new note and redirects to its page. Checks if running on the server (no document), then creates a note and redirects.

methods.name: NewNoteRedirect
methods.description: A React component that renders nothing; its primary purpose is to execute the loader logic for creating and redirecting to a new note.
